answer:
The Federation Cup is named after the **International Tennis Federation** (ITF).

The tournament was originally called the Federation Cup when it was launched in 1963 by the ITF. In September 2020, it was renamed to honor Billie Jean King, becoming the "Billie Jean King Cup."
